title: Jeff Lewis Announces 2 More Years with SiriusXM
summary: “I'm happy to announce another two years of 'Jeff Lewis Live' on Radio Andy,” Jeff said on today's show.
body_markdown:
On today’s episode of[Radio Andy’s Jeff Lewis Live](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/jeff-lewis-live) , Jeff revealed that he and SiriusXM have agreed to terms on another two years of their partnership.


[Jeff Lewis Live Hear the latest episodes Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-JeffLL)


“Yesterday at 2:50pm Pacific Daylight Time, we came to terms. I’m happy to announce another two years of *Jeff Lewis Live* on Radio Andy here at SiriusXM,” Jeff said.


“As you know, my contract ended today \[October 16\]. We did successfully come to a compromise, although we both are a little bit bruised,” he added.


Listen to the full episode on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-JeffLL) , and hear a clip from the episode above.


- **Related:[Send a Message to Jeff Lewis’ Bitch Box and Be Heard on Jeff Lewis Live](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/jeff-lewis-still-flipping-out)**


### ***Jeff Lewis Live* on SiriusXM**


Hear *Jeff Lewis Live* weekdays on Radio Andy (Ch. 101) on satellite radios and the SiriusXM app.


It’s Jeff Lewis just the way fans want him: live and uncensored. Jeff and his band of “Chumps” take on everything from the news of the day to the world of reality TV and everything in between.
